item.title: Rainfall Advisory No. 8 #NCRPRSD
item.description:
Heavy Rainfall Warning No. 8-A #NCR_PRSD
Weather System: Southwest Monsoon (Habagat)
Issued at: 3:15 PM, 28 August 2026(Friday)

RED WARNING LEVEL: Pampanga, Bataan, Zambales, Bulacan(Hagonoy, Calumpit, Pulilan, Paombong, Malolos, Plaridel, Guiguinto) and Tarlac(San Jose, Mayantoc, Camiling, San Clemente, Santa Ignacia, Capas, Bamban).
ASSOCIATED HAZARD: Serious FLOODING in flood-prone areas.

ORANGE WARNING LEVEL: Metro Manila, Rizal, Bulacan(Angat, Balagtas, Baliuag, Bocaue, Bulakan, Bustos, Meycauayan, San Jose del Monte, Dona Remedios Trinidad, Marilao, Norzagaray, Obando, Pandi, San Ildefonso, San Miguel, San Rafael, Santa Maria), Tarlac(Concepcion, Anao, Tarlac City, Gerona, La Paz, Paniqui, Pura, Ramos, San Manuel, Victoria, Moncada), Nueva Ecija(Guimba, Quezon, Licab, Aliaga, Zaragoza, Jaen, San Antonio, Gapan, Cabiao, San Isidro, San Leonardo, General Tinio, Penaranda, Santa Rosa, Cabanatuan, Palayan), Cavite(Bacoor, Imus, Kawit, Noveleta, Cavite City, Rosario, Tanza, Naic, Ternate, Maragondon) and Batangas(Nasugbu, Lian, Calatagan, Balayan, Tuy).
ASSOCIATED HAZARD: FLOODING is still THREATENING.

YELLOW WARNING LEVEL: Nueva Ecija(San Jose, Bongabon, Carranglan, Cuyapo, Gabaldon, General Mamerto Natividad, Laur, Llanera, Lupao, Nampicuan, Pantabangan, Rizal, Santo Domingo, Munoz, Talavera, Talugtug), Cavite(Alfonso, Amadeo, General Trias, General Emilio Aguinaldo, Indang, Magallanes, Mendez, Silang, Tagaytay, Trece Martires, Carmona, Dasmarinas, Gen. Mariano Alvarez), Batangas(Agoncillo, Alitagtag, Balete, Batangas City, Bauan, Calaca, Tanauan, Cuenca, Ibaan, Laurel, Lemery, Lipa, Lobo, Mabini, Malvar, Mataasnakahoy, Padre Garcia, Rosario, San Jose, San Juan, San Luis, San Nicolas, San Pascual, Santa Teresita, Santo Tomas, Taal, Talisay, Taysan, Tingloy) and Laguna(Calamba, Cabuyao, Santa Rosa, Binan, San Pedro, Mabitac, Santa Maria, Famy, Siniloan, Pangil, Pakil, Paete).
ASSOCIATED HAZARD: FLOODING in flood-prone areas.


Meanwhile, expect light to moderate with occasional heavy rains over Laguna(Alaminos, Bay, Calauan, Liliw, Los Banos, Luisiana, Magdalena, Majayjay, Nagcarlan, Pagsanjan, Pila, Rizal, Santa Cruz, Victoria, Cavinti, Kalayaan, Lumban, San Pablo) within the next 3 hours.
Light to moderate with occasional heavy rains affecting Quezon(General Nakar) which may persist within 3 hours and may affect nearby areas.
The public and the Disaster Risk Reduction and Management Offices concerned are advised to MONITOR the weather condition and watch for the next warning to be issued at 6:15 PM today.
For more information and queries, please call telephone numbers 8927-1335 and 8927-2877 or log on to www.pagasa.dost.gov.ph.
